body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes ESLint `no-useless-escape` errors in the phone validation regex and adds test coverage for phone number validation.

**Changes:**
- Fixed phone validation regex by removing unnecessary escape characters for `+`, `(`, and `)` within the character class
- Added comprehensive test cases for phone validation covering multiple valid formats and an invalid case

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/core/src/validation/validation-engine.ts | Removed unnecessary escape characters from phone validation regex |
| packages/core/src/validation/__tests__/validation-engine.test.ts | Added test coverage for phone validation with valid and invalid test cases |
